output_list.criticism: The transfer function does not check if the transfer amount exceeds the balance of the sender. This could lead to integer overflow, where the balance of the sender becomes negative. This vulnerability could be exploited by malicious users to steal tokens from other users.

The transferFrom function does not check if the transfer amount exceeds the allowance of the sender for the recipient. This could lead to integer overflow, where the allowance of the sender for the recipient becomes negative. This vulnerability could be exploited by malicious users to steal tokens from other users.

The distributeToken function does not check if the transfer amount exceeds the balance of the sender. This could lead to integer overflow, where the balance of the sender becomes negative. This vulnerability could be exploited by malicious users to steal tokens from other users.
